comments.body:
## Phase 1 — Confirmed root cause (RCA)

**Symptom:** completion verifier FAULTED at the T3 (67d4-ecba) close — a runaway
`read_file` loop (24× identical) tripped the runaway guard, which force-aborted and
truncated the evidence search; the run then reported a BLOCKING FAIL / "3 unmet criteria"
(exit 1), forcing a human to `--force`. 2 of the 3 criteria self-flagged "evidence gap, not
a demonstrated failure."

**Proven root cause (parsimonious — one origin, two compounding code seams downstream of a
correctly-firing runaway guard):**

The runaway guard fired CORRECTLY (ratio 0.042, 24 consecutive identical calls — matches the
log). A genuine loop being aborted is working-as-designed; the guard is NOT the defect. The
defect is that the *aborted/truncated* run is dispositioned as a **blocking substantive FAIL**
instead of the **non-blocking, re-runnable INDETERMINATE fault** the contract requires
(bug 2a6f: a no-verdict/truncated turn is a VERIFIER FAULT, not evidence a criterion is unmet;
46a2: runaway → typed fault; ed6d: exhaustion preserves partial evidence).

- **Seam A — mint site** (`completion_verdict_assembly.py` `_restamp_marker` :158-167, via
  `merge_finalizer_with_bank` echo branch). On the tool-free finalizer echo, a `met=false`
  record is stamped `evidence_sufficient=False` ONLY if its BANK entry carries the marker
  (`_entry_insufficient(entry)`). A criterion the abort truncated was **never banked** →
  `entry is None` → `_entry_insufficient(None)=False` → the `else` branch **pops** the marker,
  minting a BARE `met=false` indistinguishable from a positive refutation. `entry is None`
  means "never evaluated (truncated)", which is precisely insufficiency — the code treats it
  as the opposite.

- **Seam B — disposition** (`completion_reconcile.py` `reconcile_verdict`, final block
  :202-210). When the unmet set is insufficiency-only, it sets the TOP-LEVEL
  `evidence_sufficient=False` + insufficiency remediation, but does **not** set
  `verdict_obtainable=False`. The close gate's `_raise_on_verifier_fault`
  (`close_precheck.py`) keys ONLY on `verdict_obtainable is False` to take the retryable
  exit-11 path; absent it, the close falls through to the generic `returncode=1` hard block.
  So even a CLEAN insufficiency-only FAIL hard-blocks. And Seam A poisons `_insufficiency_only`
  (requires ALL unmet marked) so one bare record flips it to the generic branch anyway.

**Proof (runtime, deterministic, no LLM):** reproducer drove `reconcile_verdict` on synthetic
verdict dicts. Case B (2 marker-carrying + 1 bare `met=false`) → `_insufficiency_only=False`
→ generic blocking FAIL — reproduces the fault. Confirmed the poisoning is real and
deterministic. I independently re-read both seams (`_restamp_marker` :158-167 pops on
`entry is None`; `reconcile_verdict` sets top-level `evidence_sufficient` but never
`verdict_obtainable`; `_raise_on_verifier_fault` gates exit-11 solely on `verdict_obtainable
is False`).

**Legitimacy:** `plan_defect` (defect-class; unlocks Phase 2). Cited authority the behavior
violates: bug 2a6f contract (reconcile docstring :142-153), 46a2, ed6d.

**Defect origin (`caused_by`):** commit `6b318ffaec4a` ("Mark exhausted evidence search as
insufficient", ticket **1d71-a76c-04f6-4642**) introduced `_restamp_marker`,
`merge_finalizer_with_bank`, the `evidence_sufficient` marker, and the `reconcile_verdict`
top-level derivation. Its own message states the intent (make exhausted searches
non-blocking-insufficient, stop fabricating unmet criteria) but reveals both gaps verbatim: it
stamps the marker "authoritatively from the bank" (so an UN-banked/truncated criterion is
missed — Seam A) and "close_precheck still refuses fail-closed but reports 'insufficient'"
(insufficiency never became retryable — Seam B). Our bug is a direct escape of that ticket's
own scope. Attribution is by that introducing commit, not the fix site. `--class=plan_defect`.

**Planned fix (both, RED→GREEN, held out from fixer):**
- Fix A: on the finalizer echo, a `met=false` for a criterion with NO conclusive bank entry
  (un-evaluated/truncated) is stamped `evidence_sufficient=False` (insufficiency), NOT popped.
  Genuine refutations (conclusive bank entry, no insufficiency marker) stay bare met=false —
  guarded by a dual oracle so real failures are NOT masked.
- Fix B: `reconcile_verdict` sets `verdict_obtainable=False` on an insufficiency-only FAIL,
  routing it through the EXISTING exit-11 retryable fault path (no `close_precheck` change).

Exit 11 is re-runnable and NEVER closes the ticket, so this cannot let incomplete work close —
it only stops a verifier FAULT from masquerading as a substantive block requiring `--force`.

**Q1 (the read_file loop itself)** is a correctly-guarded genuine runaway (probabilistic LLM
behavior) — a SEPARATE hardening concern (strengthen repeated-tool-call steering to reduce
loop frequency / improve re-run convergence), filed as a discovered follow-up, not required
for this fault's correctness.

comments.body:
## Phase 2 complete — fix landed for review (Gerrit change 2219)

**Problem** — Closing S3 T3 (67d4-ecba) faulted: a runaway/exhaustion-truncated
completion-verifier run reported a BLOCKING FAIL (exit 1, "3 unmet criteria")
that only `--force` could bypass, instead of the non-blocking, re-runnable
INDETERMINATE fault the contract (bug 2a6f) requires.

**Proven root cause** — Two compounding seams downstream of a correctly-firing
runaway guard (the guard is NOT the defect):
- **Seam A (mint)** — `completion_verdict_assembly._restamp_marker` stamped the
  insufficiency marker only when the criterion's bank entry carried it. A
  truncated criterion is never banked (`entry is None`), so `_entry_insufficient(None)`
  is False → the echo branch POPPED the marker → bare `met=false` indistinguishable
  from a genuine refutation. The omitted-criterion branch of the same function
  already marked un-banked criteria insufficient; the echo branch was inconsistent.
- **Seam B (disposition)** — `reconcile_verdict` already derives top-level
  `evidence_sufficient=False` on an insufficiency-only FAIL, but the close gate and
  standalone verb only took the retryable exit-11 path when `verdict_obtainable is
  False`. Insufficiency-only still hard-blocked exit 1.

**Proof** — Held-out RED oracle (5 tests in
`tests/unit/workflow/test_insufficient_evidence_marker.py`) proven RED first, then
GREEN (45 passed). Mutation checks: revert Fix A → unbanked-echo tests RED; collapse
the disposition helper to always-1 → both retryable-disposition tests RED; restore →
GREEN. Genuine-unmet FAIL stays a hard block (guard test). Broader related suites
pass with no regressions; `make lint` (complexity ratchet new=0 increased=0) +
`make typecheck` clean.

**Defect origin** — commit `6b318ffaec4a`, ticket **1d71-a76c-04f6-4642** ("Mark
exhausted evidence search as insufficient"). Its own message reveals both gaps
("stamps... from the bank"; "close_precheck still refuses fail-closed"). Class =
**plan_defect**. `--caused-by=1d71-a76c-04f6-4642 --class=plan_defect` will be passed
on close.

**Fix** —
- Fix A: `_restamp_marker` condition → `if record.get("met") is False and (entry is
  None or _entry_insufficient(entry)):` — un-banked met=false echo stamped
  insufficient; present markerless entry (genuine refutation) stays bare.
- Fix B: new pure helper `completion_reconcile.completion_fail_returncode(result)`
  (returns 11 if `verdict_obtainable is False` OR `evidence_sufficient is False`,
  else 1); re-exported from `completion.py`; `close_precheck.py` generic raise and
  `_llm_commands.py` verify-completion verb both route through it; schema description
  updated. Does NOT overload `verdict_obtainable`; `reconcile_verdict` unchanged.

**Scope & safety** — Caller-dependency sweep: both behavioral consumers already map
`verdict_obtainable is False`→exit 11; no consumer relies on insufficiency-FAIL=exit
1. Fix restores (not creates) behaviour, adds no dependency, weakens no test. exit 11
is retryable and never closes a ticket, so making insufficiency retryable cannot let
incomplete work close.

**Siblings** — Step 7 Axis 1 (construct): single site, no siblings. Axis 2 (parity):
all disposition surfaces route through the shared helper or shared close_precheck
core; MCP surfaces the raw verdict — NO miss.

**Residual risk** — the runaway `read_file` loop that triggered the truncation is a
separate hardening opportunity, filed as bug **3dde-fd6f-8aa3-4c49**
(resident-clay-angelfish), linked `discovered_from` this bug. Not required for this
fault's correctness.

**Replication** — pending: re-run of the S3 T3 close on the fixed verifier once change
2219 lands (LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1 → Submit).

compiled_state.description:
A runaway/exhaustion-truncated completion-verifier run is dispositioned as a BLOCKING
substantive FAIL (exit 1, requires --force) instead of the non-blocking, re-runnable
INDETERMINATE fault the contract requires (bug 2a6f; 46a2; ed6d). Root cause confirmed (RCA
comment). Two compounding seams downstream of a correctly-firing runaway guard, both from
ticket 1d71-a76c-04f6-4642 (commit 6b318ffaec4a).

## Root cause (proven)
- Seam A (mint): `completion_verdict_assembly._restamp_marker` stamps the per-criterion
  insufficiency marker only when the criterion's BANK entry carries it; a criterion the abort
  truncated is NEVER banked (`entry is None`), so the marker is POPPED, minting a bare
  `met=false` indistinguishable from a positive refutation. The OMITTED-criterion branch of the
  same function already stamps un-banked criteria insufficient — the ECHO branch is
  inconsistent.
- Seam B (disposition): reconcile_verdict already derives the top-level
  `evidence_sufficient=False` marker on an insufficiency-only FAIL (since 1d71), but the close
  gate (`close_precheck`) and the standalone `verify-completion` verb (`_llm_commands`) still
  raise the fail-closed exit 1 for it. Only a `verdict_obtainable=False` fault (the no-criterion
  fault, bug 2a6f) currently takes the retryable exit-11 path.

## Approach (two behavior-preserving fixes; reuse the EXISTING evidence_sufficient marker)
- Fix A — `completion_verdict_assembly._restamp_marker`: a finalizer-echoed `met is False`
  record whose criterion has NO bank entry (`entry is None` — never evaluated/truncated) is
  stamped `evidence_sufficient=False`, making the echo branch consistent with the omitted
  branch. Keys STRICTLY on `entry is None`, NOT on any bank-entry evidence-cap `truncated`
  flag: a PRESENT markerless entry is a genuine refutation and stays bare (failures not masked).
- Fix B — a single shared pure helper `completion_fail_returncode(result)` (added to
  completion_reconcile, re-exported from `rebar.llm.completion`) returns the retryable 11 when
  the FAIL is a fault (`verdict_obtainable is False` OR `evidence_sufficient is False`), else 1.
  Both consumers call it, so their disposition is identical by construction. NO overload of
  `verdict_obtainable` (its schema stays the no-criterion fault); routed on the existing
  `evidence_sufficient` marker. The insufficiency-accurate close message already exists in
  `_verification_fail_message` — only the returncode changes.

## Impacted sites
- src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_verdict_assembly.py — `_restamp_marker` (Fix A).
- src/rebar/llm/completion_reconcile.py — new `completion_fail_returncode` helper (Fix B).
- src/rebar/llm/completion.py — re-export `completion_fail_returncode`.
- src/rebar/_commands/close_precheck.py — the generic completion-FAIL raise uses
  `completion_fail_returncode(result)` for its returncode (was hard-coded 1).
- src/rebar/_cli/_llm_commands.py — the `verify-completion` verb returns
  `completion_fail_returncode(result)` on a non-PASS (was hard-coded 1).
- src/rebar/schemas/completion_verdict.schema.json — update the `evidence_sufficient`
  description: its close/verb disposition is now the retryable exit-11 fault, not fail-closed.
- Unchanged consumer (noted for completeness): src/rebar/llm/completion_sidecar.py already
  persists the top-level `evidence_sufficient` marker onto the durable record (since 1d71) — no
  new durable-record behavior.
- tests/ — new deterministic regression tests (no LLM).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] An insufficiency-only FAIL (top-level `evidence_sufficient=False`, incl. un-banked
  `met=false` echoes) disposes as retryable exit 11 via `completion_fail_returncode`; the
  ticket does not close.
- [ ] A completed run with a genuinely-refuted criterion (met=false, no insufficiency marker)
  still disposes as exit 1 — genuine failures are not masked (dual assertion).
- [ ] The pre-existing no-criterion fault (`verdict_obtainable=False`, 2a6f) still disposes
  exit 11 — undisturbed.
- [ ] `merge_finalizer_with_bank` stamps `evidence_sufficient=False` on an un-banked
  `met=false` echo (entry is None), and leaves a present markerless entry bare.
- [ ] `verdict_obtainable`'s schema/meaning is unchanged (no overload); `evidence_sufficient`
  schema doc updated to the retryable disposition.
- [ ] Deterministic regression tests (no LLM) cover all; `make lint` + `make typecheck` clean;
  complexity ratchet not increased.

## Portability
No CI-provider coupling: pure in-process verdict reconciliation/assembly/disposition logic,
exercised by deterministic unit tests that run under any/no CI provider.

## Test plan
Held-out RED oracle drives `merge_finalizer_with_bank` and the shared
`completion_fail_returncode` helper on synthetic verdict/bank dicts; asserts the exit-11
insufficiency disposition, the preserved 2a6f exit-11 fault, and the non-masking exit-1 genuine
block; mutation-check by restoring the pop / collapsing the helper to always-1.

file_impact.reason: Fix A: un-banked (entry is None) met=false echo stamped insufficiency, not popped
Fix B: new completion_fail_returncode shared disposition helper
Fix B: generic completion-FAIL raise uses completion_fail_returncode (retryable 11 for insufficiency)
Fix B: verify-completion verb uses completion_fail_returncode
evidence_sufficient disposition doc: now retryable exit-11, not fail-closed
document the new exit-11 disposition for insufficiency-only completion FAIL (api-compat)
